name: Lunar Folly
source:
Within the remote village of Aberon, rumors swirl of a werewolf, residing in the nearby forest and endangering the locals. Expecting nothing, the village's hunter, Michail, sets out to disprove the magical beast's existence... only to come face to face with him, on one moonlit night.

When the two begin talking, however, Michail finds himself quite charmed by the werewolf, and his foreign way of life.  With every conversation, every bit of information that he manages to claw from the beast, Michail's convictions about his own life start to waver.

Why is it that the villagers fear the power of magic so much?

Why is it that he's soon getting married, when even his own fiancee knows damn well that he has no interest in her?

And when there's so much wrong with his current life...

Why hasn't he just given up already and joined the wolf's pack?

[From [url=https://chmron.itch.io/lunar-folly]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在偏远的阿伯伦村庄里，有传言称狼人居住在附近的森林里，危害着当地人。村里的猎人米凯尔一无所获，他出发去证明这只魔兽的存在……结果却在一个月夜与他面对面。

然而，当两人开始交谈时，米歇尔发现自己被狼人以及他的异国生活方式迷住了。随着每一次谈话、从这头野兽身上获取到的每一条信息，米凯尔对自己生活的信念都开始动摇。

为什么村民们如此惧怕魔法的力量？

为什么他快要结婚了，连他自己的未婚妻都清楚地知道他对她没有兴趣？

当他目前的生活有这么多问题时……

为什么他还不放弃并加入狼群呢？

[来自[url=https://chmron.itch.io/lunar-folly]itch.io[/url]]
